better.instructions: `first` and `second` are two passages of novels. Which of the two is the better written?

enjoy.instructions: `first` and `second` are two passages of novels. Which of the two would most readers enjoy reading more?

remarks: Calibration, after the first ten were seen: twelve pieces against the panel of anchors, both ways round, asked which most readers would enjoy more instead of which makes a reader more eager to read on.
